amendment.reason: A pre-execution smoke test found that the generator property CSV and persisted SDF canonical-SMILES multisets were not positionally or chemically linkable: 45/1443 molecules overlapped in one prospective TargetDiff job, and 34/486 overlapped in one completed primary TargetDiff job.
amendment.change: Recompute QED and favorable SA directly from each persisted SDF, deduplicate exact canonical-SMILES/QED/SA triples within each job, and select the cell top 50 from those coordinate-bearing records.
amendment.unchanged: source run, conditions, pockets, seeds, top-k, score weights, tie breakers, geometry thresholds and claim limits
amendment.r01_status: preserved as a zero-output pre-execution mapping failure; its controller was never started

candidate_selection.score: 0.70 * RDKit_QED + 0.30 * favorable_SA, recomputed from each persisted SDF
candidate_selection.favorable_SA: (10 - Ertl_SA) / 9 rounded to two decimals, using the same generator implementation
candidate_selection.deduplication: exact canonical-SMILES/QED/favorable-SA triples within each source job
candidate_selection.selection_time: after the source final manifest is terminal; no outcome-dependent threshold changes

geometry.pocket_compatible: all generated heavy atoms lie within 10 A of at least one reference-ligand heavy atom

primary_outputs: condition-level pocket compatibility and clash-free rates
selected model allocation by condition and pocket
molecule-level traceability to source job and SDF
claim_limits: The analysis is conditional on the frozen QED and favorable-SA top-50 selection rule recomputed from persisted coordinate files.
These coordinate-bearing top-50 sets are separate from the source finalizer's unlinked property-CSV top-50 sets and cannot be used as exact molecule-level validation of those sets.
Pocket compatibility and receptor clashes are geometric computational signals and do not establish binding affinity.
Generating-model strata describe selected candidate composition and geometry; they do not isolate causal model effects.
Docking and PLIP are outside this run and require a separate frozen protocol.
